🔥 siyuan | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a secure, self-hosted environment for users to organize, manage, and connect their knowledge, with integrated AI capabilities for enhanced productivity and insight generation.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source and privacy-first • Self-hosted knowledge workspace • Local-first architecture • AI agent integration for collaboration • Supports Markdown, S3, PDF, WebDAV
📖 Summary: SiYuan is an open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace designed for individuals and AI agents to collaborate. It functions as a local-first application, supporting Markdown, S3, PDF, and WebDAV for data storage and synchronization, enabling users to build personal knowledge bases and digital gardens.
